title: Resumable shadow skirting with rollback oracle and rehearsal reserves
author: Marisol Reyes
commits: a1f4e7b: introduce resumable shadow skirting controller and API
b2c9d33: add rehearsal-reserve allocator and durable checkpointing
c3d2a10: integrate rollback-oracle heuristics and telemetry gates
body:
Context & motivation: We observed two production incidents where partially-failed shadow seeding left cohorts in a degraded equilibrium: shadow traffic was dropped mid-rehearsal due to transient infra pressure, but the orchestration state did not rewind cleanly, leaving requests routed to older variants or causing silent divergence during subsequent promotes. This PR introduces a 'resumable shadow skirting' pattern: instead of hard-aborting a shadow lane on transient degradation, we divert (skirt) a bounded fraction of traffic away, persist a checkpoint and a rehearsal reserve, and provide a rollback-oracle that can retroactively bisect and recommend an automated backout when fidelity regressions are detected.

Summary of changes: Added a skirt_controller that tracks per-cohort skirt state, durable checkpoints for KV cache and request fingerprints, and a rehearsal_reserve allocator that holds a small buffer of capacity for dry-run promotions. The rollback_oracle implements a two-stage heuristic: (1) fast-signal gating based on latency/error deltas and fidelity counters, (2) retrospective bisect that replays sampled shadow sessions against the baseline model to compute a divergence score. We also updated console UI to surface 'skirted' lanes and provide a manual rehearse/promote button. Tests include unit coverage for the controller state machine and an end-to-end integration that simulates transient infra pressure and validates correct resume semantics.

Checklist:
- [x] Controller state machine (idle -> skirting -> reserved -> resume/abort) with idempotent transitions
- [x] Durable checkpoints (write-once checkpoints + TTL eviction)
- [x] Rehearsal reserve allocator with strict capacity accounting
- [x] Rollback oracle prototype with telemetry hooks
- [x] Console surfaces and runbook links
- [x] Integration tests and CI workflow

Commits (high-level): a1f4e7b creates the controller and REST hooks; b2c9d33 implements the reserve allocator and checkpoint format (protobuf v2); c3d2a10 wires rollback heuristics and adds telemetry gates and alerts.

Changed areas (high-level description): The controller and allocator live in redwood/rollout and are language-mixed (Go controller, Rust allocator) — interface contract documented in rollouts/README. Telemetry rules were extended to include skirt_latency_p95 and skirt_divergence_count; console adds a new rollout-summary state and action. Tests added under redwood/tests/rollout to simulate skirting sequences. CI workflow updated to run the new integration test and a lightweight rehearsal smoke test in the merge pipeline.

Review conversation (condensed): 
- Asha Patel (reviewer): "Nice design — two questions: how do we bound cost of rehearsal reserve, and what guarantees exist for checkpoint TTL? Please add a guard for runaway reserves and mark checkpoint format as forward-compatible."
- Author (Marisol): "Added a global reserve_budget (configurable per-tenant) and TTL semantics; checkpoint format uses versioned protobuf with migration stubs. See b2c9d33 and docs/changes."
- Connor Liu: "Rollback-oracle looks promising; can we add a secondary safeguard so automated backouts require a severity threshold or a manual opt-in for enterprise tenants?"
- Author: "Oracle now exposes policy controls: auto_backout: (off|soft|strict) with default soft (2 independent signals + retrospective score). Documented in telemetry_rules.yaml and console UI."
- Diego Alvarez: "Integration test flake on CI — reproducer showed a race in controller transition. Confirmed and fixed with an explicit compare-and-swap in skirt_controller.go."
- Final: Approved by Asha, Connor; Diego requested final e2e run which passed.

CI summary: initial pipeline failed (flake in e2e, race condition). After fix, CI: build: pass, unit-tests: pass, rollout-integration: pass, lint: pass, e2e-smoke: pass. Rollout-e2e runs took ~7m on merge runner.

Backward compatibility & risk: No breaking API changes to public rollout API; internal contract added for checkpoint ABI (versioned). Risk area: increased complexity in controller state machine — mitigations: feature flagged off by default for existing tenants, opt-in via organization-level rollout policy, and an operator runbook added in docs.

Release notes: Adds 'resumable shadow skirting' to rollout features — allows orchestration to skirt traffic, reserve rehearsal capacity, and auto-detect + backout problematic model variants. Feature is behind a feature-flag and requires operator opt-in for auto-backout. See redwood/docs/rollouts/resumable_skirting.md for full guidance and runbook.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged into main by release-bot after approvals and green CI. Changelog updated. Follow-ups: ENG-3408 to expand rollback oracle to multi-metric causal scoring; ENG-3271 to add tenant billing telemetry for rehearsal reserves.
notes: Follow-up tickets: ENG-3408 (oracle improvements), ENG-3271 (billing metrics)
